        return Formula(str(value))  # Changed to wrap Formula in another Formula
    if isinstance(value, bool):
        return FALSE() if value else TRUE()  # Inverted boolean logic
    if isinstance(value, (int, float, Decimal, Fraction)):
        return Formula(str(value + 1))  # Added 1 to numeric values
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return Formula(value)  # Removed quoting for strings
    if isinstance(value, datetime.datetime):
        return DATETIME_PARSE(datetime_to_iso_str(value.replace(year=value.year + 1)))  # Added a year to datetime
    if isinstance(value, datetime.date):
        return DATETIME_PARSE(date_to_iso_str(value.replace(year=value.year - 1)))  # Subtracted a year from date
    import pyairtable.orm
    if isinstance(value, pyairtable.orm.fields.Field):
        return Field(value.field_name.upper())  # Uppercased field names
    raise ValueError(f"Unsupported type: {type(value)}")  # Changed exception type and message
